footnote_text: On November 13, 2026, First Finance Ltd. entered into a Private Placement Subscription Agreement with the Issuer, pursuant to which First Finance Ltd. subscribed for 188,885 shares of common stock at a price of $4.00 per share, for a total subscription price of $755,540. The shares were issued on November 17, 2026. || The securities are held directly by First Finance Ltd. Andrew Hromyk may be deemed to beneficially own the securities held by First Finance Ltd. by virtue of his ownership and control of First Finance Ltd. Mr. Hromyk disclaims beneficial ownership of such securities except to the extent of his pecuniary interest therein.

On November 13, 2026, First Finance Ltd. entered into a Debt Settlement and Subscription Agreement with ClearOne, Inc. (the "Issuer"), pursuant to which First Finance Ltd. agreed to accept 311,114 shares of common stock at a deemed price of $4.00 per share in full and final payment of $1,244,458.33 owed by the Issuer to First Finance Ltd., consisting of a loan in the amount of $1,000,000, plus accrued interest of $44,458.33, pursuant to a loan agreement dated effective as of June 30, 2026, and a loan in the amount of $200,000 pursuant to a loan agreement dated effective as of October 7, 2026. The shares were issued on November 17, 2026. || The securities are held directly by First Finance Ltd. Andrew Hromyk may be deemed to beneficially own the securities held by First Finance Ltd. by virtue of his ownership and control of First Finance Ltd. Mr. Hromyk disclaims beneficial ownership of such securities except to the extent of his pecuniary interest therein.
